window.grid: windows start at 0, 5, 10, ... s from the start of the recording; features use only samples in [t_start, t_end) after one causal filter pass over the whole stream

personal_z: (x - mean_cal) / max(sd_cal, floor); mean_cal, sd_cal (ddof 1) over the wearer's calibration windows (windows fully inside the first 5 min of rest, same length and step); floor = median sd_cal of the TRAINING subjects (a model constant shipped with the model)

features.name: hr_mean
features.definition: BVP 64 Hz; causal Butterworth band-pass 0.7-3.5 Hz, order 3 per edge, SOS with state carried across the stream (steady-state start). In the window: scipy find_peaks(distance = int(0.33*fs) samples, prominence = 0.3 x SD of the filtered window); peak time refined by a 3-point parabola; IBI = successive differences; keep 0.33 s < IBI < 1.5 s; drop IBIs with |IBI - median| >= 0.3 x median; need >= 5 peaks and >= 4 IBIs else NaN; HR = 60 / IBI; hr_mean = mean of HR over the kept IBIs

features.name: hr_std
features.definition: BVP 64 Hz; causal Butterworth band-pass 0.7-3.5 Hz, order 3 per edge, SOS with state carried across the stream (steady-state start). In the window: scipy find_peaks(distance = int(0.33*fs) samples, prominence = 0.3 x SD of the filtered window); peak time refined by a 3-point parabola; IBI = successive differences; keep 0.33 s < IBI < 1.5 s; drop IBIs with |IBI - median| >= 0.3 x median; need >= 5 peaks and >= 4 IBIs else NaN; HR = 60 / IBI; hr_std = population SD (ddof 0) of HR over the kept IBIs

features.name: rmssd
features.definition: BVP 64 Hz; causal Butterworth band-pass 0.7-3.5 Hz, order 3 per edge, SOS with state carried across the stream (steady-state start). In the window: scipy find_peaks(distance = int(0.33*fs) samples, prominence = 0.3 x SD of the filtered window); peak time refined by a 3-point parabola; IBI = successive differences; keep 0.33 s < IBI < 1.5 s; drop IBIs with |IBI - median| >= 0.3 x median; need >= 5 peaks and >= 4 IBIs else NaN; HR = 60 / IBI; RMS of successive IBI differences (ms). EXCLUDED: does not track chest ECG (Step A)

features.name: sdnn
features.definition: BVP 64 Hz; causal Butterworth band-pass 0.7-3.5 Hz, order 3 per edge, SOS with state carried across the stream (steady-state start). In the window: scipy find_peaks(distance = int(0.33*fs) samples, prominence = 0.3 x SD of the filtered window); peak time refined by a 3-point parabola; IBI = successive differences; keep 0.33 s < IBI < 1.5 s; drop IBIs with |IBI - median| >= 0.3 x median; need >= 5 peaks and >= 4 IBIs else NaN; HR = 60 / IBI; SD (ddof 0) of kept IBIs (ms). EXCLUDED (Step A)

features.name: pnn50
features.definition: BVP 64 Hz; causal Butterworth band-pass 0.7-3.5 Hz, order 3 per edge, SOS with state carried across the stream (steady-state start). In the window: scipy find_peaks(distance = int(0.33*fs) samples, prominence = 0.3 x SD of the filtered window); peak time refined by a 3-point parabola; IBI = successive differences; keep 0.33 s < IBI < 1.5 s; drop IBIs with |IBI - median| >= 0.3 x median; need >= 5 peaks and >= 4 IBIs else NaN; HR = 60 / IBI; fraction of |successive IBI differences| > 50 ms. EXCLUDED (Step A)

features.name: scl_mean
features.definition: EDA 4 Hz (uS); causal Butterworth low-pass 1.0 Hz, order 2, SOS with state; phasic = low-passed EDA - tonic, tonic = causal EMA with tau 8.0 s (a = 1 - exp(-1/(tau*fs)), fs 4 Hz); scl_mean = mean of the tonic in the window. Absolute level

features.name: eda_std
features.definition: EDA 4 Hz (uS); causal Butterworth low-pass 1.0 Hz, order 2, SOS with state; SD (ddof 0) of the low-passed EDA in the window. Gain-dependent

features.name: eda_slope
features.definition: EDA 4 Hz (uS); causal Butterworth low-pass 1.0 Hz, order 2, SOS with state; least-squares slope of the low-passed EDA vs time (s) over the window. Offset-invariant, gain-DEPENDENT

features.name: eda_slope_rel
features.definition: eda_slope / sigma_lp_cal, sigma_lp_cal = SD (ddof 0) of the low-passed EDA samples over the calibration period; wearer's calibration period = first 5 min of the rest (baseline) condition; the per-wearer constant is computed from the stream samples in that period and stored on the device. Gain- and offset-invariant

features.name: scr_count
features.definition: EDA 4 Hz (uS); causal Butterworth low-pass 1.0 Hz, order 2, SOS with state; phasic = low-passed EDA - tonic, tonic = causal EMA with tau 8.0 s (a = 1 - exp(-1/(tau*fs)), fs 4 Hz); number of find_peaks(phasic, prominence >= 0.01 uS, distance >= 1 s) in the window. Offset-invariant, gain-DEPENDENT (fixed absolute prominence)

features.name: scr_count_rel
features.definition: as scr_count but prominence >= 1.0 x sigma_ph_cal, sigma_ph_cal = SD (ddof 0) of the phasic samples over the calibration period; wearer's calibration period = first 5 min of the rest (baseline) condition; the per-wearer constant is computed from the stream samples in that period and stored on the device. Gain- and offset-invariant

features.name: scr_amp_mean
features.definition: mean prominence of the scr_count peaks (0 if none). Gain-dependent absolute amplitude

features.name: temp_mean
features.definition: TEMP 4 Hz (degC) -> 1 Hz by block mean of 4 samples (causal); mean over the window. Absolute level (sensor offset, session drift)

features.name: temp_slope
features.definition: TEMP 4 Hz (degC) -> 1 Hz by block mean of 4 samples (causal); least-squares slope vs time (s) over the window

features.name: acc_mag_mean
features.definition: ACC 32 Hz, raw / 64 -> g; magnitude = sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2); mean of the magnitude over the window

features.name: motion_energy
features.definition: ACC 32 Hz, raw / 64 -> g; magnitude = sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2); population SD (ddof 0) of the magnitude over the window
